Real photos of resistors, for tests/test_resistor.py and tests/eval_resistor_real.py.

Each file shows one resistor lying lengthwise, cropped to about 10:3. The file
name is the bands as they appear left to right, then the source.

  *_array.jpg   crops of "Electronic-Axial-Lead-Resistors-Array.jpg",
                Wikimedia Commons, public domain.
  *_82R.jpg     crop of "Resistor metal film 0.5W 1% 82R.jpg",
                Wikimedia Commons, CC0.

Cut by tools/fetch_resistor_photos.py. These seven were never used to train
the reader. They are sharp studio photos: passing on them does not show the
reader works through a head-worn camera in classroom light.
